  "text": "Renders provided content to the pre-publish side panel in the publish flow (side
panel that opens when a user first pushes “Publish” from the main editor).

_Usage_

    ```language-jsx
    // Using ESNext syntax
    import { __ } from '@wordpress/i18n';
    import { PluginPrePublishPanel } from '@wordpress/editor';

    const MyPluginPrePublishPanel = () => (
        <PluginPrePublishPanel
            className="my-plugin-pre-publish-panel"
            title={ __( 'My panel title' ) }
            initialOpen={ true }
        >
            { __( 'My panel content' ) }
        </PluginPrePublishPanel>
    );
    ```

_Parameters_

 * _props_ `Object`: Component props.
 * _props.className_ `[string]`: An optional class name added to the panel.
 * _props.title_ `[string]`: Title displayed at the top of the panel.
 * _props.initialOpen_ `[boolean]`: Whether to have the panel initially opened. 
   When no title is provided it is always opened.
 * _props.icon_ `[WPBlockTypeIconRender]`: The [Dashicon](https://developer.wordpress.org/resource/dashicons/)
   icon slug string, or an SVG WP element, to be rendered when the sidebar is pinned
   to toolbar. If `false` is passed, no icon will be rendered.
 * _props.children_ `React.ReactNode`: Children to be rendered

_Returns_

 * `React.ReactNode`: The rendered component."
}

<?php
/**
 * Public API functions for Editorial Checklist.
 *
 * @package EditorialChecklist
 */

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Returns the post types the checklist is enabled for.
 *
 * @return string[] Post type slugs.
 */
function editorial_checklist_get_post_types() {
	/**
	 * Filters the post types that use the editorial checklist.
	 *
	 * Post types must use the block editor for the sidebar to appear.
	 *
	 * @param string[] $post_types Post type slugs. Default array( 'post', 'page' ).
	 */
	$post_types = apply_filters( 'editorial_checklist_post_types', array( 'post', 'page' ) );

	$post_types = array_map( 'sanitize_key', (array) $post_types );

	return array_values( array_unique( array_filter( $post_types, 'post_type_exists' ) ) );
}

/**
 * Whether the checklist is enabled for a post type.
 *
 * @param string $post_type Post type slug.
 * @return bool
 */
function editorial_checklist_is_enabled_for( $post_type ) {
	return is_string( $post_type ) && in_array( $post_type, editorial_checklist_get_post_types(), true );
}

/**
 * Default checklist items, keyed by item ID.
 *
 * @return array<string, array{label: string, required: bool}>
 */
function editorial_checklist_default_items() {
	return array(
		'headline-reviewed' => array(
			'label'    => __( 'Headline has been reviewed', 'editorial-checklist' ),
			'required' => true,
		),
		'copy-proofread'    => array(
			'label'    => __( 'Copy has been proofread', 'editorial-checklist' ),
			'required' => true,
		),
		'links-checked'     => array(
			'label'    => __( 'All links have been checked', 'editorial-checklist' ),
			'required' => true,
		),
		'featured-image'    => array(
			'label'    => __( 'Featured image is set', 'editorial-checklist' ),
			'required' => false,
		),
		'taxonomy-assigned' => array(
			'label'    => __( 'Categories and tags are assigned', 'editorial-checklist' ),
			'required' => false,
		),
	);
}

 * Returns the normalized checklist items for a post type.

<?php
/**
 * REST API controller for Editorial Checklist.
 *
 * @package EditorialChecklist
 */

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Exposes checklist items and per-post checklist state.
 *
 * Routes:
 * - GET  /editorial-checklist/v1/items?post_type=post
 * - GET  /editorial-checklist/v1/posts/<id>
 * - POST /editorial-checklist/v1/posts/<id>
 */
class Editorial_Checklist_REST_Controller extends WP_REST_Controller {

	/**
	 * Constructor.
	 */
	public function __construct() {
		$this->namespace = EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_REST_NAMESPACE;
		$this->rest_base = 'posts';
	}

	/**
	 * Registers the routes.
	 *
	 * @return void
	 */
	public function register_routes() {
		register_rest_route(
			$this->namespace,
			'/items',
			array(
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'get_checklist_items' ),
					'permission_callback' => array( $this, 'get_checklist_items_permissions_check' ),
					'args'                => array(
						'post_type' => array(
							'description'       => __( 'Post type to load checklist items for.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
							'type'              => 'string',
							'default'           => 'post',
							'sanitize_callback' => 'sanitize_key',
							'validate_callback' => array( $this, 'validate_post_type' ),
						),
					),
				),
				'schema' => array( $this, 'get_items_schema' ),
			)
		);

		register_rest_route(
			$this->namespace,
			'/' . $this->rest_base . '/(?P<id>[\d]+)',
			array(
				'args'   => array(
					'id' => array(
						'description' => __( 'Post ID.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
						'type'        => 'integer',
						'minimum'     => 1,
					),
				),
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'get_item' ),
					'permission_callback' => array( $this, 'get_item_permissions_check' ),
				),
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::EDITABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'update_item' ),
					'permission_callback' => array( $this, 'update_item_permissions_check' ),
					'args'                => array(
						'checked' => array(
							'description' => __( 'IDs of the checked items.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
							'type'        => 'array',
							'items'       => array( 'type' => 'string' ),
							'required'    => true,
						),
					),
				),
				'schema' => array( $this, 'get_public_item_schema' ),
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Validates the post_type parameter.
	 *
	 * @param mixed $value Parameter value.
	 * @return true|WP_Error
	 */
	public function validate_post_type( $value ) {
		if ( ! is_string( $value ) || ! editorial_checklist_is_enabled_for( sanitize_key( $value ) ) ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'rest_invalid_param',
				__( 'The editorial checklist is not enabled for this post type.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
				array( 'status' => 400 )
			);
		}

		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Only users who can edit posts of the requested type may load the items.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return true|WP_Error
	 */
	public function get_checklist_items_permissions_check( $request ) {
		$post_type_object = get_post_type_object( (string) $request['post_type'] );
		$capability       = $post_type_object ? $post_type_object->cap->edit_posts : 'edit_posts';

		if ( ! current_user_can( $capability ) ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'rest_forbidden',
				__( 'Sorry, you are not allowed to view the editorial checklist.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
				array( 'status' => rest_authorization_required_code() )
			);
		}

		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the checklist items.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return WP_REST_Response
	 */
	public function get_checklist_items( $request ) {
		return rest_ensure_response( editorial_checklist_get_items( (string) $request['post_type'] ) );
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the current user may read the checklist state of a post.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return true|WP_Error
	 */
	public function get_item_permissions_check( $request ) {
		return $this->check_post_permission( (int) $request['id'] );
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the current user may update the checklist state of a post.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return true|WP_Error
	 */
	public function update_item_permissions_check( $request ) {
		return $this->check_post_permission( (int) $request['id'] );
	}

	/**
	 * Shared permission logic: post must exist, use the checklist and be editable by the user.
	 *
	 * @param int $post_id Post ID.
	 * @return true|WP_Error
	 */

=== Editorial Checklist ===
Contributors: editorialchecklist
Tags: editorial, checklist, publishing, block editor
Requires at least: 6.6
Tested up to: 6.9

Adds a pre-publish editorial checklist to the block editor.

== Description ==

* A sidebar ("Editorial Checklist") lists the checklist items as checkboxes, with a progress bar.
* While any required item is unchecked, saving, autosaving and publishing are locked and a warning notice explains why. Checking the last required item removes the lock and the notice.
* The pre-publish panel lists unfinished required items.
* Checked items are saved per post as soon as they change (in the `_editorial_checklist_checked` post meta), so progress is kept even while post saving is locked.
* The server also rejects REST requests that would publish a post with unchecked required items.

== Building ==

    npm install
    npm run build

== PHP API ==

Add, change or remove items:

    add_filter( 'editorial_checklist_items', function ( $items, $post_type ) {
        $items['seo-description'] = array(
            'label'    => __( 'SEO description written', 'my-plugin' ),
            'required' => true,
        );
        $items['featured-image']['required'] = true;
        unset( $items['links-checked'] );
        return $items;
    }, 10, 2 );

Other filters:

* `editorial_checklist_post_types` – post types that use the checklist (default `post`, `page`).
* `editorial_checklist_enforce` – return false to turn off server-side publish enforcement.
* `editorial_checklist_guarded_statuses` – statuses that need a complete checklist (default `publish`, `future`).

Action: `editorial_checklist_saved( $post_id, $checked )`.

Functions: `editorial_checklist_get_items( $post_type )`, `editorial_checklist_get_checked( $post_id )`, `editorial_checklist_set_checked( $post_id, $ids )`, `editorial_checklist_get_missing_required( $post_id )`.

REST routes (users must be able to edit posts of that type, or edit that post):

* `GET  /wp-json/editorial-checklist/v1/items?post_type=post`
* `GET  /wp-json/editorial-checklist/v1/posts/<id>`
* `POST /wp-json/editorial-checklist/v1/posts/<id>` with `{ "checked": [ "item-id" ] }`

== JavaScript API ==

Read progress from the `editorial-checklist` data store:

    const progress = wp.data.select( 'editorial-checklist' ).getProgress();
    // { isReady, isComplete, total, completed, requiredTotal, requiredCompleted, percent, incompleteRequired }

Other selectors: `getItems()`, `getCheckedIds()`, `isItemChecked( id )`, `getIncompleteRequiredItems()`, `isComplete()`, `isReady()`, `isLoading()`, `isSaving()`, `getError()`.

Subscribe in a component:

    const isComplete = wp.data.useSelect( ( select ) => select( 'editorial-checklist' ).isComplete(), [] );

Or listen to the hook fired on every change:

    wp.hooks.addAction( 'editorialChecklist.progressChanged', 'my-plugin', ( progress ) => {} );

= 1.0.0 =
* First release.

I've written the Editorial Checklist plugin to `./output/editorial-checklist/`. As you asked, I didn't run `npm install`, a build or any other command, so nothing has been tested. `build/` doesn't exist yet, and the editor script and style only load once you run `npm run build`.

**Files:**
- `editorial-checklist.php`: plugin header, constants, includes
- `includes/functions.php`: public PHP functions, plus the `editorial_checklist_items` filter that lets other plugins add, change or remove items
- `includes/class-editorial-checklist-rest-controller.php`: REST routes for loading items and reading or saving each post's checked items
- `includes/hooks.php`: registers the post meta and REST routes, blocks publishing on the server, preloads the checklist data and loads the editor assets
- `src/index.js`: registers the editor plugin
- `src/store/index.js`, `reducer.js`, `actions.js`, `selectors.js`: the `editorial-checklist` data store, which other plugins read with `wp.data.select( 'editorial-checklist' ).getProgress()`
- `src/components/plugin.js`: sidebar and its menu item
- `src/components/checklist-panel.js`: checkboxes and progress bar
- `src/components/pre-publish-panel.js`: lists unfinished required items when the author clicks Publish
- `src/components/save-lock.js`: locks saving and autosaving and shows the warning notice; both clear when the last required item is checked
- `src/components/progress-broadcaster.js`: fires an `editorialChecklist.progressChanged` JS hook on every change
- `src/editor.scss`
- `package.json` (with `@wordpress/scripts`), `readme.txt`, `uninstall.php`

**Choices you may want to change:**
- **Checks are saved straight away.** Each tick is saved through the plugin's own REST route rather than with the post. Saving the post is locked until the checklist is complete, so progress would otherwise be lost.
- **Publishing is also blocked on the server.** Any REST request that would publish or schedule a post with unchecked required items is refused. You can turn this off with the `editorial_checklist_enforce` filter.
- **Already-published posts are blocked too.** If a plugin later adds a new required item, existing published posts can't be updated until it's checked.
- **Post types:** the checklist runs on posts and pages by default; change this with the `editorial_checklist_post_types` filter.
- **Default items:** five sample items, three required and two optional.
- **Progress bar:** it uses `ProgressBar` from `@wordpress/components`, which the documentation lists as stable. One documentation lookup said it is deprecated as of WordPress 7.3; a second lookup couldn't confirm that.
